BaseInput.description: Input of the inner method, exactly as that method accepts it. It is validated by the inner method at run time against its own schema; this schema does not describe it.

base_input.description: Input of that method, complete, including the variable at any starting value.

bracket.description:
`[low, high]`, low < high: the variable is searched in this interval, and the output
minus the target must change sign between its ends (or meet the tolerance at one end).

max_iterations.description: Largest number of evaluations after the two bracket ends, from 1 to 1000. Default: 100.

method.description: Id of the method to evaluate, for example `dcf.fcff`. Analysis methods are not accepted.

output.description:
RFC 6901 JSON Pointer to the decimal output of the method, in its `value`, for example
`/enterprise_value`.

target.description: Value the output must reach, in the output's units.

tolerance.description:
Absolute tolerance on the output, in the output's units, greater than 0. Default:
0.000000001.

variable.description: RFC 6901 JSON Pointer to the decimal input to solve for, for example `/discount_rate`.
